messages.subject: Forcely re-computing a reactive value?
parts:
Dear all,

I have an app in where I first point to a directory that contains a GIT repository (this is done in tab1). That directory is stored using a reactive value called "proj_dir()". Later on, I have another tab in which I want to track changes in my GIT folder, for this, I created the following code using personal library to wraps some external functions (mylib) :

# Load repository
git_repo <- reactive({git2r::repository(proj_dir())})

# Check for files that have been not added to the latest commit
files_to_commit<-eventReactive({c(input$f_commits,input$tabs,input$commit)},{
    unname(unlist(git2r::status(git_repo(),all_untracked = TRUE)))
  })

# Print message with pending files
output$status <- renderText({
  if(!is.null(files_to_commit())){
      paste(files_to_commit(),collapse="\n") 
  }
  else{
      "No pending files or changes were found"
  }
})

commit_pending<-observeEvent(input$commit,{
  config_repo(git_repo(),input$username,input$useremail)
  mylib::commit_files(git_repo(),files_to_commit(),input$message_commit)
  output$commit_succes<-renderText("All files are up do date")
})

However, I would like the files_to_commit() to reload/recalculate after committing (this is why files_to_commit is event reactive to input$commit amongst others). I haven't been able to make it work in such a way that once I commit, the file_to_commit() is updated, and it  finally triggers the output$statis with the message that no pending files were found. Is there a way to force a reactive expression to be recalculated? I guess that the code inside is not triggered since git_repo() is the same but haven't come with a way to fix it.

Regards,

messages.subject: Re: Forcely re-computing a reactive value?
parts: When we need to do this, we usually introduce a reactiveVal for no other reason than to trigger that eventReactive. Read the trigger reactiveVal from the eventReactive's eventExpr, and write to it from the observer that does the commits.
